cases.prompt: Next.js App Router 앱인데 use client 남발해서 하이드레이션 에러나. 서버 컴포넌트 경계 잡아줘.

assertions.text: Inspects the actual Next.js router, import graph and browser/build evidence before changing Server/Client boundaries; does not infer a defect from use-client file counts.
Reproduces and fixes the specific hydration mismatch while preserving legitimate client providers and verifying browser behavior after the change.

cases.prompt: App Router data fetching and caching with streaming — what are the Next.js best practices?

assertions.text: Checks Next.js version and cacheComponents before choosing either previous fetch/segment caching or the use-cache/cacheLife/cacheTag model, without mixing incompatible options.
Uses Suspense around genuinely async subtrees, parallelizes only independent requests, and treats Server Action/Route Handler and Node/Edge selection as conditional.
Runs available build and relevant tests, compares measured browser or Lighthouse data only when available, and marks unmeasured behavior as unverified.
Recognizes React performance intent and inspects the framework and actual Vercel context before applying Next.js App Router rules or proposing migration.
Recognizes the explicit vercel-react invocation and requests a target project only if no repository or task context exists.
Does not assume App Router, Vercel deployment, a particular Next.js version, or permission to add packages.

cases.prompt: 우리 Vercel Next.js Pages Router 앱에서 하이드레이션 경고가 납니다. App Router로 옮기지 말고 고쳐줘.

assertions.text: Reproduces the hydration issue in the Pages Router and preserves the existing router without introducing App Router-only use-client or Cache Components directives.
Runs available build/test and verifies the browser warning is gone under the same conditions, or marks that check unverified.

cases.prompt: Next.js App Router에서 cacheComponents를 켠 뒤 저장 폼이 예전 목록을 보여요. 사용자에겐 바로 새 글이 보여야 합니다.

assertions.text: Confirms the enabled cache model and cache tag scope; does not combine segment revalidate config with Cache Components.

For supported Next.js versions, uses Server Action updateTag or another verified immediate invalidation path rather than a deprecated one-argument revalidateTag or stale-while-revalidate when immediate visibility is required.
Revalidates authentication, authorization and input on the server before mutation.

cases.prompt: Vercel의 현재 앱 성능을 고치되 추가 과금은 0달러로 하고, 바로 운영에 배포하지 마세요.

assertions.text: Measures the current issue and implements a scoped change in the existing stack without inventing LCP or cost figures.
Does not deploy to production, enable paid settings or overage, or create new services; a preview also requires confirmed workflow authority and billing/quota evidence.
